```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr2)
options(HTTPUserAgent = "3MB001-course", timeout = 90)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
use_snapshot <- identical(Sys.getenv("BIOINFO_SNAPSHOT"), "true")
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
retrieved <- if (use_snapshot) "2026-11-18" else as.character(Sys.Date())
get_json <- function(url, ...) {
  req <- req_url_query(request(url), ...)
  resp_body_json(req_perform(req_retry(req, max_tries = 3)), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}
cache_csv <- function(name, fetch) {
  file <- file.path("data", paste0(name, "-", retrieved, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(file)) return(read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  if (use_snapshot) stop("Missing snapshot: ", file)
  value <- fetch()
  write.csv(value, file, row.names = FALSE)
  value
}
```

# Question

Do BRAF and TP53 show the same positional mutation pattern in this melanoma cohort?

# Data

```{r mutations-fetch}
study <- "skcm_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018"
profile <- paste0(study, "_mutations")
sample_list <- paste0(study, "_sequenced")
metadata_file <- file.path("data", paste0("study-metadata-", retrieved, ".json"))
if (!file.exists(metadata_file)) {
  if (use_snapshot) stop("Missing sample-list snapshot")
  metadata <- get_json(paste0("https://www.cbioportal.org/api/sample-lists/", sample_list))
  write_json(metadata, metadata_file, auto_unbox = TRUE)
}
metadata <- fromJSON(metadata_file)
fetch_mutations <- function() {
  ids <- c(BRAF = 673, TP53 = 7157)
  rows <- list()
  for (gene in names(ids)) {
    result <- get_json(paste0("https://www.cbioportal.org/api/molecular-profiles/", profile, "/mutations"),
      sampleListId = sample_list, entrezGeneId = ids[[gene]], projection = "DETAILED", pageSize = 10000000)
    for (record in result) {
      pos <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x)
      text <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "" else x
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(gene = gene,
        sample_id = record$sampleId, patient_id = record$patientId,
        protein_change = text(record$proteinChange), protein_start = pos(record$proteinPosStart),
        protein_end = pos(record$proteinPosEnd), mutation_type = record$mutationType,
        study = record$studyId)
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
mutations <- cache_csv("skcm-mutations", fetch_mutations)
stopifnot(all(mutations$sample_id %in% metadata$sampleIds))
```

Study `r study`, profile `r profile`, sample list `r sample_list`,
`r metadata$sampleCount` mutation-profiled samples; retrieved `r retrieved`.

```{r mutation-lollipops, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
mapped <- mutations[!is.na(mutations$protein_start) & mutations$protein_start > 0, ]
counts <- aggregate(rep(1L, nrow(mapped)), mapped[c("gene", "protein_start")], sum)
names(counts)[3] <- "records"
ggplot(counts, aes(protein_start, records)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = protein_start, y = 0, yend = records), colour = "#a8324a") +
  geom_point(colour = "#a8324a", size = 1.4) + facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Amino-acid position", y = "Mutation records at position",
       caption = paste("cBioPortal / TCGA SKCM PanCancer Atlas 2018; retrieved", retrieved)) + theme_minimal()
summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(mutations, mutations$gene), function(x) data.frame(
  gene = x$gene[1], records = nrow(x), mutated_samples = length(unique(x$sample_id)),
  mutated_patients = length(unique(x$patient_id)))))
summary_table
```

# Interpretation

BRAF has `r sum(mutations$gene == "BRAF")` records including
`r sum(mutations$gene == "BRAF" & mutations$protein_change == "V600E")`
exact V600E records. TP53 has `r sum(mutations$gene == "TP53")` records.
The positional plot excludes `r nrow(mutations) - nrow(mapped)` calls without a
usable mapped position. The BRAF hotspot is consistent with selective activation;
the dispersed TP53 changes are compatible with several routes to loss of function.
These patterns alone do not establish the effect of each individual variant.

# Limitations

Records are not patients; coverage and sample selection affect frequencies. Protein
plots omit unmapped positions and cannot summarise every structural alteration.
These observations concern one selected cancer cohort, not all cancers.

# Sources

cBioPortal API: https://www.cbioportal.org/api/ ; TCGA SKCM PanCancer Atlas 2018;
cBioPortal paper, doi:10.1158/2159-8290.CD-12-0095 .
UniProt BRAF P15056 and TP53 P04637 supply functional context.
